title: The Four-Phase Founder Pipeline
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Entrepreneurship
description: A step-through infographic of the Clarity, Validation, Action, and Launch phases. Each phase shows its definition, Jordan's concrete example, and a prompt to predict the next move; a return arrow shows that Validation can send a founder back to Clarity.

prerequisites: Chapter 1: Entrepreneurship, Lean Thinking & the Idea Trap
learningObjectives: Explain the purpose of each of the four phases in your own words
Explain how the phases connect into a repeating cycle rather than a one-time sequence

controls.label: Next / Back to Clarity
controls.purpose: Step forward one phase; on Launch, loop back to Clarity

controls.label: Phase boxes and return arrow
controls.purpose: Jump to a phase or show the pivot explanation

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Step-through worked example with predict-before-advancing prompts
keyQuestions: What evidence would send Jordan from Validation back to Clarity?
Why does Launch loop back to Clarity instead of ending the process?
commonMisconceptions: The four phases are a checklist completed once
Action means building the full product
assessmentOpportunities: Explain each phase without reading the definition
Write your own one-line Clarity and Validation examples
